style: Cinematic live-action TV commercial frame, shot on ARRI Alexa with anamorphic-look long lenses, Riyadh business district at hard midday sun, teal-steel colour grade with crushed blacks and warm skin tones, heat haze, subtle film grain, photorealistic, 16:9. No text, no logos, no real brands, no police or government insignia.
interior_style: Cinematic live-action TV commercial frame, contemporary Najdi-modern penthouse on the 20th floor in Riyadh, warm limestone, low majlis seating, floor-to-ceiling slim matte-black aluminium sliding glass wall with 20 mm frames, warm sand colour grade, soft film grain, photorealistic, 16:9. No text, no logos.

characters.rider: stunt rider in full black leathers and a mirrored black helmet (face never visible) on a black superbike
characters.director: film director in his 40s, navy cap, aviator sunglasses, beige vest, holding a white megaphone
characters.grandfather: Saudi grandfather in his early 70s, kind eyes, short white beard, white thobe and white taqiyah
characters.girl: Saudi girl aged 8, dark hair tied back, simple cream home dress, deeply focused

negative: text, captions, watermark, logo, cartoon, CGI look, distorted hands, extra fingers, warped faces, gun, weapon

02.keyframe: Wide long-lens shot down a glass-tower boulevard: the {rider} blasts toward camera; a parked car's hazard lights flash; a white patrol SUV with generic blue-red light bar swings out from the kerb behind.
02.motion: The superbike races toward and past camera left; the SUV pulls out and accelerates after it; slight long-lens heat shimmer; camera pans with the bike.

03.keyframe: Medium shot through a windscreen line of gridlocked cars on a Riyadh avenue, a frustrated driver in a white thobe leans on the horn, another driver throws both hands up.
03.motion: Drivers gesture in exasperation, horns pressed, cars inch forward, handheld energy.

05.keyframe: Low tracking shot at road level: the {rider} leans the superbike into acceleration, front wheel lifting slightly, motion-blurred asphalt and towers.
05.motion: Camera tracks low alongside then whips to follow as the bike accelerates hard past the lens, strong motion blur.

07.keyframe: High drone view of a circular roundabout with an olive tree at its centre; seven white patrol SUVs with flashing generic light bars drift around it in a comic convoy.
07.motion: Drone slowly orbits as the SUVs drift around the roundabout one after another, tyre smoke.

08.keyframe: Medium shot on a sunny sidewalk: a Saudi businessman in a crisp white thobe and shemagh presses a phone to one ear and jams a finger in the other, shouting.
08.motion: He shouts into the phone, wincing at the noise, passers-by and traffic behind.

09.keyframe: Medium close-up of a construction worker in a hard hat operating a jackhammer on a road, dust bursting up, orange barriers.
09.motion: Jackhammer pounds rhythmically, dust and debris spray, static camera.

11.keyframe: Wide low-angle shot between two glass towers: a white news helicopter rises into frame; its downwash whips a shemagh off a surprised passer-by in the foreground.
11.motion: The helicopter rises and fills the frame, the shemagh flies off and flutters away, camera tilts up.

12.keyframe: Medium tracking shot: the {rider} splits lanes between two city buses, travelling right to left.
12.motion: The bike threads quickly between the buses from right to left, camera tracking alongside.

13.keyframe: Rapid-montage frame: laundry on a rooftop line thrashing in helicopter downwash against glass towers.
13.motion: Laundry whips violently in the wind, dust swirling.

14.keyframe: Wide crane shot revealing a film set on the boulevard: camera cranes, big film lights, a crew, and a stunt ramp; the {director} raises a megaphone; the {rider} lines up at the far end of the ramp.
14.motion: Camera cranes up to reveal the set; the director lifts the megaphone and shouts; the bike launches toward the ramp.

15.keyframe: Wide shot, backlit by a low sun: the {rider} is airborne off a ramp in front of a tall glass tower, silhouetted, slow-motion feel.
15.motion: The bike soars through the air in slow motion, silhouette against the sun, lens flare.

04.keyframe: Medium two-shot in the penthouse: the {grandfather} gently guides the fingers of the {girl} on a bamboo reed pen at a low wooden writing desk beside the wide-open sliding glass wall; a sheer curtain whips in the wind; city towers outside.
04.motion: The curtain billows; the girl begins writing carefully; the grandfather steadies her hand; slow push in.

06.keyframe: Extreme close-up of a child's hand holding a reed pen on cream paper; the black ink line wobbles.
06.motion: The pen wobbles slightly as she flinches, ink line trembling.

10.keyframe: Close-up of the {girl} wincing and covering one ear at the desk; a drop of black ink falls from the pen onto the paper; the {grandfather} turns his head toward the window behind her.
10.motion: She winces and covers her ear, an ink blot falls, the grandfather slowly turns to look at the window.

18.keyframe: Close-up of a weathered elderly hand turning a slim matte-black aluminium window handle.
18.motion: The hand turns the handle firmly downward, locking the window.

19.keyframe: Locked-off wide interior: the {grandfather} and the {girl} sit perfectly still at the desk in golden light, dust motes floating; behind them, through the closed floor-to-ceiling glass wall, a film crew runs and a news helicopter hovers silently.
19.motion: Inside, stillness and floating dust; outside the glass, distant figures run and the helicopter hovers.

21.keyframe: Medium close-up two-shot in golden backlight: the {girl} looks up proudly from her paper; the {grandfather} smiles with eyes closed; behind them through the glass, the {director} on the street below shouts into a megaphone.
21.motion: The girl looks up and smiles, the grandfather smiles serenely; outside, the director shouts silently.
